t: Outside access device with lever operation for use with all Briton exit hardware. Provides a simple means of entry from the outside by any key holder. Suitable for single and double doors between 40mm to 100mm thick. Supplied with 40mm euro profile standard differ cylinder. Anti-vandal design with clutch mechanism allows the lever to rotate when the unit is locked. Ideal for back of house or emergency exit doors.
b: Fire Door Rating: FD30, FD60 (Timber) & Not Suitable for Steel Fire Doors
Supplied with Euro Cylinder as Standard
Suitable for Single or Double Doors
